decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system fits growing demand for flexible workplaces and builds on the core office offer, so the option still has upside and costs little to keep.
A chair family close to the established offer is cheap to maintain within existing production, and premium seating lines usually stay in the catalogue for many years.
The floor cushions are a niche accessory whose value is still uncertain, but the line has stayed presented on the website and costs little to carry alongside the rug business.
The designer sofa by EOOS was actively promoted and sits close to the core upholstery competence, so its value is likely being realized.
A high standing table close to the established offer costs little to keep, although it is a minor product whose prospects remain moderately uncertain.
The rug collection is a flagship that opens a new strategic direction, and despite its distance from the core offer the option is worth keeping open while its uncertainty resolves.
